MATCH (s:Statute)-[:CONTAINS_PROVISION]->(p:Provision)
WHERE toLower(s.state) = 'alabama'
WITH s, p,
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'eviction' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'unlawful detainer' THEN 18 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'unlawful detainer' THEN 18 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'residential' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AreaOfLaw) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'landlord' OR toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'housing' } THEN 12 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.type IN ['Procedure or Process', 'Notice Requirement', 'Duty or Obligation'] THEN 8 ELSE 0 END)
  AS score
WHERE score > 0
WITH s, p, score
ORDER BY score DESC
WITH s, max(score) AS score, head(collect(p)) AS best
OPTIONAL MATCH (best)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:Condition)
WITH s, best, score, collect(DISTINCT {number: c.number, description: c.description}) AS conditions
RETURN s.idx AS statute_idx, s.citation AS citation, s.summary AS source_summary, best.rule AS provision_rule, conditions, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 20

  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'saturday' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'sunday' THEN 12 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN toLower(p.rule) CONTAINS 'holiday' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AreaOfLaw) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'procedure' } THEN 8 ELSE 0 END) +
  (CASE WHEN p.type IN ['Procedure or Process', 'Restriction or Prohibition', 'Duty or Obligation'] THEN 8 ELSE 0 END)
  AS score
WHERE score > 0
WITH s, p, score
ORDER BY score DESC
WITH s, max(score) AS score, head(collect(p)) AS best
OPTIONAL MATCH (best)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:Condition)
WITH s, best, score, collect(DISTINCT {number: c.number, description: c.description}) AS conditions
RETURN s.idx AS statute_idx, s.citation AS citation, s.summary AS statute_summary, best.rule AS provision_rule, conditions, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 20
